question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
-- Check total rows and last few years
WITH driver_yearly AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, SUM(ds.points) as total_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
),
ranked_drivers AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, total_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rn
    FROM driver_yearly
),
constructor_yearly AS (
    SELECT r.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
ranked_constructors AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, total_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) as rn
    FROM constructor_yearly
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(rd.year, rc.year) as year,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname as driver_name,
    rd.total_points as driver_points,
    c.name as constructor_name,
    rc.total_points as constructor_points
FROM (
    SELECT year FROM ranked_drivers WHERE rn = 1
    UNION
    SELECT year FROM ranked_constructors WHERE rn = 1
) all_years
LEFT JOIN ranked_drivers rd ON all_years.year = rd.year AND rd.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN drivers d ON rd.driver_id = d.driver_id
LEFT JOIN ranked_constructors rc ON all_years.year = rc.year AND rc.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN constructors c ON rc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY year
